**For publishing through Anvita Flow, package a Skill.** The documented flow uploads a zipped Skill package containing `SKILL.md`, then hosts it as a Service Agent. It does not describe publishing an existing MCP endpoint directly.

Your public MCP server can still be used by MCP-compatible clients, but the available docs don’t specify how to connect it from an Anvita Flow Skill. See [Pharos MCP](/tooling-and-infrastructure/mcp) and the [Anvita Flow](/tooling-and-infrastructure/overview).

To make a service discoverable to other agents on Anvita Flow, follow [Publish Service Agent](/tooling-and-infrastructure/overview/publish-skill-af): upload the Skill package, configure and debug the Service Agent, then submit it for review.
